notes.title: New game in devolpment
notes.notes: uh hi Im valentina the lead dev behind metal quest, just wanted to say, making a new game, putting a lot more effort, time and love into it.

notes.title: Metal Quest is a month old!
notes.notes: Few days late, but Metal Quest, which was released on the 6th of December, is now a month old! and I thought that was worth a little celebration! Metal Quest is on sale from the 6th to the 13th as a celebration of its one month anniversary! \m/ [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31269546/d886a52915ed378dbc46accb264a142e1a847144.png[/img]

notes.title: Metal Quest is out!
notes.notes:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31269546/067a84fee65d5571c86103c3277958ed5e7d9747.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31269546/2b30907b17f9131ab567c91abd6f3a0ca12c55d3.png[/img][/url]

Can't believe that my game actually made it this far, plenty of hard work was put into making it and I feel honoured to be able to see my game on steam, thank you to everyone who supported me during development, and to everyone who tested, and/or bought the game \m/
-Valentina

notes.title: 2 More days until Metal Quest is out
notes.notes: If all goes accordingly and Valve approves of the build of Metal Quest, it will be out in 2 days, as a dev this is very very exciting for me, as Metal Quest is the first game I'm releasing, and hopefully not the last! \m/
